categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development, production, sales, and technical services of machine vision inspection equipment. The main products are 3D Solder Paste Inspection (3D SPI) equipment and 3D Automatic Optical Inspection (3D AOI) equipment, which are applied in SMT production lines and semiconductor packaging processes for quality inspection of various PCB types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include proprietary light source systems, machine vision software algorithms (both bottom-layer and application-layer), AI artificial intelligence algorithms, and high-precision mechanical platforms. The company employs a 'standardized production + semi-customized development' model, utilizing programmable structured light grating technology and 3D surface profile measurement technology for product inspection and analysis.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, lithium batteries, semiconductors, and communications equipment industries. The products are applied in SMT production lines for quality inspection and in semiconductor backend packaging processes. The company's customer base includes major manufacturers in these sectors, with the top five customers accounting for 18.79% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with 99.31% of revenue from domestic markets in 2023. The company has established branch offices and service centers in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chongqing, Tianjin, and Suzhou. The company is expanding internationally, with plans to establish a subsidiary in Hong Kong to strengthen overseas market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures and sells inspection equipment to electronics manufacturers and semiconductor companies. The company sources core components domestically and has achieved full self-research and localization of main components used in its equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on developing new quality production capacity through continuous R&D innovation. Key R&D initiatives include: upgrading 3D SPI and 3D AOI products with advanced algorithms and AI modules, developing X-ray inspection (AXI) equipment, implementing AI-assisted one-click programming for AOI, and expanding applications in emerging fields like MicroLED and MiniLED. The company invested 25.82 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 7.02% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of machine vision inspection equipment. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of the equipment after installation, debugging, and acceptance. The company also provides technical services and rental services. In 2023, direct sales accounted for 58.62% of revenue and distribution sales for 41.38%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the 3D machine vision inspection equipment market in China. It has achieved import substitution and competes effectively with overseas manufacturers. The company is recognized as a 'National Specialized and Innovative Small Giant Enterprise' by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and holds the status of a national high-tech enterprise. The company's 3D SPI maintains market leadership, while 3D AOI sales grew 108.24% year-over-year.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 367.84 million yuan (down 5.04% from 387.35 million yuan in 2022) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 99.39 million yuan (down 14.55% from 116.31 million yuan in 2022). The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange's ChiNext board on November 28, 2023, raising 526.99 million yuan in net proceeds. Total assets increased to 1.093 billion yuan at year-end 2023 from 512.30 million yuan at year-end 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: advanced 3D machine vision technology with superior measurement stability and precision, proprietary AI-assisted intelligent algorithms for improved detection efficiency, comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple application scenarios, strong technical support and localized service capabilities, and cost-effective solutions compared to overseas competitors. The company emphasizes innovation-driven development and provides integrated inspection solutions for customers' production lines.
